scope: Cold test of Understand the Assignment, Understand the Practice, and Plan the Research only.

supplied_assignment.original_title: What Is the Difference Between a Lip Flip and Lip Filler?
supplied_assignment.reference_label: The Skin Center MD – Lip Flip vs. Lip Filler Reference
supplied_assignment.section_label_note: Lisa is retained as the assignment's writer grouping, not substituted for Vikas or treated as a practice provider.
special_instructions: Use actual treatments, providers, technology, patient experience and local market; do not create a generic practice-name substitution.
Research the client website before third-party sources; supplied references are starting points, not text to rewrite.
Use the style guide and the assignment's stated quality characteristics. Dontage example remains unopened under this cold trial.
Include relevant providers, multiple useful internal links, appropriate authoritative outbound links, and a customized consultation CTA.
Use approved provider quotes when available; do not fabricate quotations. Flag a useful placement if an approved quote is unavailable.
Use official Facebook/Instagram and genuine attributable Google reviews where applicable and useful; do not manufacture evidence.
Support both SEO and AI/AEO discovery through direct answers, useful entity context and natural geography despite the SEO label.
Use readable H1/H2/H3 structure, short paragraphs, useful FAQs when appropriate, and at least 1,200 substantive words.

working_hypothesis.target_reader: An adult considering lip enhancement at Estar or in its Olney-area market who wants to understand which treatment could suit their lip goals before a consultation.
working_hypothesis.article_purpose: Explain the practical difference between a lip flip and lip filler, then help that reader prepare informed questions about goals, expected effects, timing, maintenance, risks and suitability for an Estar consultation.

evidence.supports: Assigned comparison title implies a reader who needs to distinguish two options; it supplies no demographics or keyword rationale.
Estar publishes dedicated pages and consultation routes for both options.
Listed Olney location and individualized consultation approach support local consultation context.

working_hypothesis.limits: Adult reader, decision stage, and Olney-area relevance are working inferences. Do not invent gender, age band, income, first-time status, patient demographics, or a Potomac location. No alternative hypothesis is maintained.
working_hypothesis.revision_trigger: Revise if Alex supplies a different target reader, search intent or geography, or later evidence changes the practice treatment context.

interpretation_boundaries.medical_answer_status: Not resolved in these stages; service-page descriptions are evidence of published practice context, not independent medical verification.

claims_implied_or_needed.claim_to_investigate: The treatments differ in mechanism and in whether they add lip volume.
Different lip goals and anatomy may make one, both or neither appropriate.
Onset, duration, recovery and maintenance differ; numerical ranges require treatment-specific evidence.
Comparative cost, naturalness, safety, candidacy and reversibility must not be assumed.
Estar advertises both services; current availability, exact products and the providers performing each remain distinct questions.
